notes: Conductor size is the nominal cross-sectional area in mm². "cableType" selects which construction/table applies (each dimensional parameter is tagged with appliesTo). "cores" is the number of cores; "class" is conductor class (1 solid, 2 stranded, 5 flexible) and is only relevant to the single-core rigid overall-diameter parameter.

For dimensional parameters, valueTable combinations that are not offered by the standard for that product are marked {"value":"Not specified in IS (combination not offered)"} - all such blanks were read from the printed tables (dashes "-").

Nominal insulation/sheath thickness are given as the nominal reference (limitType min); per Cl 5.3 the smallest measured value must not fall below nominal by more than (0.1 mm + 0.1·ti), and per Cl 8.3 the smallest sheath value not below nominal by more than (0.1 mm + 0.15·ts).
Flat-cable and parallel-twin overall dimensions are W×H (text) as printed in Tables 7 and 10.

Sampling (Annex A / Table 11) is excluded by design. Tensile/elongation, insulation resistance and conductor resistance limits are defined by reference to IS 5831 / IS 8130 (they vary by PVC compound type / conductor class, not by the size·cores parameterization).
